messages:
jordan: heads up — in eu-west1 we see a cluster of GPUs flipping between OK and ECC_ERROR_RATE spikes + occasional net timeout to the host manager.
maria: ugh. how many nodes? any jobs impacted? :grimacing:
jordan: 3 nodes showing repeated ECC bursts, 2 more with transient XID 31s, total 5. a couple of Slurm jobs got preempted when kubelet started evicting pods.
li: can we avoid full drain? maybe a soft-cordon + preflight checks before eviction. soft-cordon -> allow running jobs to finish, block new allocations.
samir: agree. proposal: mark node as soft-cordon label like gpu_health=degraded, run quick memtest + nvml diag, if fail -> staged drain with staggered time windows across AZ to keep capacity.
jordan: +1. also network blips look correlated with one Top-of-Rack switch in eu-west1-b — might be causing NVidia driver flakiness. ops-bot: incident created: INC-2025-309 — attaching logs: https://internal/logs/INC-2025-309
maria: commands for the soft flow:```
# soft cordon
kubectl label node nvidia-abc gpu_health=degraded --overwrite
kubectl cordon nvidia-abc
# leave pods running, don't evict; run diagnostics
ssh infra@node "sudo /opt/bin/nvml-diagnostics --quick"
```
li: what about Slurm nodes? need equivalent: scontrol update NodeName=node[01] State=ALLOCATE? or set reason and drain after grace.
samir: Slurm flow: set node state=DRAIN with reason, set time limit to let jobs finish:```
scontrol update NodeName=nodeX State=DRAIN Reason="gpu-ecc-degraded" TimeLimit=01:30:00
``` then run diag.
jordan: if diag fails, we run a rolling drain across the five nodes with 10m stagger. kubectl drain should use --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=300
maria: add a retry/backoff: if drain fails due to network, don't force evict on first attempt. escalate to manual after 3 attempts.
li: also add a routing rule: traffic to eu-west1-b GPU pool will prefer dedicated reserve if >20% of nodes in pool are in 'degraded' tag to avoid SLA hits.
ops-bot: perf-cost note: moving jobs to reserved pools increases cost by ~1.8x — flagged for finance review.
samir: we should auto-create a ticket to replace cards after N failures within 30d. what threshold? 3 XID+ECC events within 72h => replace board.
jordan: +1 on replacement threshold. ops-bot: automation task queued: TASK-4821 add soft-cordon flow + diag + staggered drain.
maria: I'll draft the runbook and include exact kubectl/slurm commands, diag steps, and whom to page. pinging @oncall for review.
li: one more: record a metric 'gpu_health_flap' per node and a 5m debouncing window to prevent churn-triggered drains.
jordan: sounds good. I'll start the diag runs and label the nodes. will update thread with results.
ops-bot: update: node nvidia-abc diag returned "ECC_ERROR_RATE high" — proceeding to staged drain (10m stagger).
